description.value: You know how to quickly weave together a fiendish clause that severs a devil's tie to this realm. You can cast a 5th-rank banishment once per day as a divine innate spell. You can only cast this spell targeting a devil, but you can spend an extra action to give the target a –2 circumstance penalty to its save without preparing special anathema.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
